aws-ecr-repository-disallow-mutable-imag.reason: zenobase-api tags must stay MUTABLE: Snyk scans a fixed `latest` tag re-pointed on every release.

aws-ecr-repository-configure-image-scan.reason: zenobase-api images are scanned out-of-band by Snyk, not ECR scan-on-push, to avoid duplicate triage.

aws-ecr-repository-configure-customer-ma.reason: zenobase-api uses explicit AES256 (always encrypted); a CMK would force repo replacement = image loss.

aws-ec2-securitygroup-disallow-public-in.reason: The internet-facing ALB SG must allow 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 by design.

aws-secretsmanager-secret-configure-cust.reason: The single ARN-scoped secret is acceptably protected by the AWS-managed key; a CMK isn't justified.

aws-s3-bucket-enable-replication-configu.reason: zenobase-lb-logs holds disposable ALB access logs (90-day expiry); cross-region replication is unwarranted.

aws-s3-bucket-enable-server-side-encrypt.reason: zenobase-lb-logs already uses S3 default SSE-S3 (AES256); KMS/CMK unjustified for a log bucket, and declaring inline SSE would surface 3 KMS/bucket-key/CMK findings.
